prompt:
Practice nets on a dusty Indian maidan at dawn: a net cage, a set of stumps, a kit bag and a water bottle, a tree, long shadows and mist. Painted like a vintage Indian sports-magazine centre spread from the 1980s: deep outfield greens, chalk white and cherry red, dramatic angle, faded glossy print. Wide panoramic composition: the main subject sits in the left third of the frame. Towards the right the same scene carries on, quieter and darker: open sky, distance and shadow, nothing important there, one continuous picture with no panels and no split. Full-bleed edge to edge, no border, no frame, no people, no faces, no hands. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no badges, no religious symbols, no writing anywhere.
[FLUX.2 klein 4B, 8-bit, mflux, 4 steps, 1536x864, seed 7405; edits: margins cropped 3%; resized 1440x810; magazine print finish: 12 colours, dot screen, red shift]
